name: qbuilder/qbuilder
description: SQL Query Builder with fluent interface supporting multiple database drivers (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MSSQL, Oracle, ClickHouse)

suggest.ext-pdo: PDO extension for database connectivity (required for actual database operations)
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: PDO MySQL driver for MySQL/MariaDB support
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: PDO PostgreSQL driver for PostgreSQL support
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: PDO SQLite driver for SQLite support
suggest.ext-pdo_oci: PDO Oracle driver for Oracle Database support
suggest.ext-pdo_dblib: PDO dblib driver for MS SQL Server support
suggest.ext-pcov: PCOV extension for code coverage analysis (recommended for faster coverage)
